title: 2.2 Firewall Disarm (3 Cases)
concept: BST deletion: leaf, one child, two children
objective: Disarm 3 firewall nodes in order by clicking them: Leaf (80) -> 1-Child (20) -> 2-Child (30)!
start_status: Step 1/3: Click Leaf node 80 to disarm it.
hints: Delete the leaf first - a leaf has no children to reconnect.
A node with exactly one child is replaced by that child. Find the one-child node.
A node with two children is replaced by its inorder successor. Click the two-child node.
